name: supabase
description: The Postgres development platform. Supabase gives you a dedicated Postgres database to build your web, mobile, and AI applications.
one_liner: A ready-made backend for apps — database, logins, file storage, and real-time updates — all built on regular Postgres, so a small team can launch an app without building that plumbing themselves.
buyer: A solo founder or small dev shop building a new app who wants Firebase-like speed without being locked into a proprietary vendor.
business_use_cases: An indie founder launches an MVP in days instead of months by using it as the entire backend.
An agency standardizes on it across client projects to cut backend build time and increase margin on fixed-price contracts.
A two-person team builds a niche vertical SaaS (e.g. salon scheduling) entirely on top of it without a backend engineer.

money_ideas.idea: Build and launch a vertical SaaS product on top of it, billed monthly to end customers
Offer 'Supabase setup and migration' consulting for teams moving off Firebase

steal_this: This weekend, build and launch a small vertical SaaS MVP on top of it and start charging a subscription within two weeks.
